name: Jimmy Powell and the Five Dimensions

podcast.title: Backing Millie Small (1964)
podcast.body: This band provided the instrumental backing for Millie Small's hit single "My Boy Lollipop." They were hired by Ernest Ranglin for the recording. "Wranglin hired a local band to perform the instrumental backing. That band Jimmy Powell and the Five Dimensions."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Previous Identity (pre-1964)
podcast.body: Before performing as Jimmy Powell and the Five Dimensions, the band was known as The Moon Trekkers. "That band Jimmy Powell and the Five Dimensions had previously been known as the Moon Trekkers."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Joe Meek Collaboration
podcast.body: As The Moon Trekkers, the band had worked with producer Joe Meek, recording the song "Night of the Vampire." "had worked with Joe Meek recording Night of the Vampire."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
